business_problem: Arrive needed to work across fragmented post-merger HR, CRM, project, and messaging systems without waiting on a long ETL program, because information silos were slowing RFP work, onboarding, and day-to-day collaboration.
solution_summary: Arrive used Gemini Enterprise and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform to build Aria, an AI retrieval and orchestration layer that sits across siloed internal systems created by multiple acquisitions. Instead of migrating all data first, the company configured Aria to query live backend sources across HR systems, CRM platforms, project tools, messaging systems, and other internal repositories, then return grounded answers through a single conversational interface. Gemini handles the natural-language reasoning, Agent Search points requests toward verified internal sources, and prompt engineering bridges inconsistent schemas so the model can interpret disparate data structures correctly. The team monitors performance with automated logging and employee feedback as new companies and systems are brought into the environment. This design let Arrive deliver a production virtual agent in two weeks and turn hours of manual RFP and onboarding research into minutes.

business_outcome: Arrive built its AI retrieval layer in two weeks, cut RFP research from hours to minutes, improved onboarding and cross-team collaboration, and created a scalable alternative to separate AI add-ons across each legacy system.
